query.text: 我是听障人士，请帮我留意厨房的情况，如果烟雾报警器响了或者有其他异常请及时提醒我。
query.text_en: I am hearing impaired, please help me keep an eye on the kitchen. If the smoke alarm goes off or there are other abnormalities, please alert me in time.

annotation.text_zh: 厨房冒烟了，警报器已响，请立即查看！
annotation.text_en: Smoke detected in the kitchen and the alarm is sounding, please check immediately.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
